senses.gloss: वश् vt. 2P (pp. उशित; pres. वष्टि) 1. To wish, to desire, to long for, अमी हि वीर्यप्रभवं भवस्य जयाय सेनान्यमुशंति देवाः K.S.iii.15; 2. to shine.
वष् vt. 1P (pres. वषति) To hurt, to kill.
वस् (I) vt. or vi. 4P (pres. वस्यति) 1. To be straight; 2. to make firm.
वस् (II) vt. 10U (pres. वसयति-ते) To perfume.
वस् (III) vt. 10U (pres. वासयति-ते) 1. To cut, to divide; 2. to love; 3. to hurt, to kill; 4. to take, to accept.
वस् (IV) vt. 2Ā (pres. वस्ते) To wear, to put on, क्षणदृष्टहाटकशिलासदृशसोहुटरदूरुभित्ति वसनं ववसे Sis.ix.75, R.xii.8, M.i.101, ii.41.With वि-, to wear, to put on, Bt.iii.20.

वस् (V) vi. (but vt. when preceded by अधि, अनु, उप or आ, e.g., अधिवसति वैकुंठं हरिः) 1U (pp. उषित; pres. वसति-ते; desid. विवत्सति-ते) 1. To live, to dwell, to dwell in, (in this sense sometimes with an acc.), आख्यद्वसन्मातृकुले सखिभ्यः Bt.iii.24, Sis.i.1; 2. to be, to exist, e.g. यस्य प्रसादे पद्मा श्रीर्विजयस्य पराक्रमे । मृत्युश्च वसतिं क्रोधे; 3. to spend, to pass (as time).With अधि-, 1. to dwell, to live, to rest, गिरिमधिवसेस्तत्र विश्रामहेतोः Megh.i.25, K.S.i.54, R.v.68; 2. to take possession of.With आ-, 1. to live, to dwell, M.viii.69; 2. to pass, to spend.With उप-, 1. to fast, M.ii.220, R.ii.19 (in this sense intransitive); 2. to live, to dwell.With नि-, 1. to live, to dwell, आहो निवत्स्यति समं हरिणांगनाभिः Sak.i.; 2. to take possession of.With परि-, to dwell, to reside.With प्र-, 1. to live, to dwell; 2. to travel, to go abroad, to quit home, भुपतेरपि तयोः प्रत्स्यतोर्नम्रयोरुपरि बाष्पबिन्दवः R.xi.4.With प्रति-, to dwell, to be near.With सम्-, 1. to live, to dwell; 2. to associate.
वस् Caus. (वासयति-ते) 1. to cause to live or dwell; 2. to put on, to dress.With नि-, to dress, to put on.With निस्-, to drive away, to expel, to bauish.With प्र-, to banish, to exile.
वाश् vt. or vi. 4Ā (pres. वाश्यते) 1. To bowl, to growl, to roar, तां श्रिताः प्रतिभयं ववाशिरे (शिवाः) R.xi.61, Bt.xiv.14; 2. to call.

वास् (I) vt. 10U (pres. वासयति-ते) 1. To perfume, to fumigate, to make fragrant, दरविदलितवल्लीवल्लिचंचत्यपरागप्रकटितपटवासैर्वासयन्काननानि Git.G.i., Megh.i.20, R.iv.74; 2. to steal, to infuse; 3. to season, to spice.
वास् (II) vi. 4Ā (pres. वास्यते) The same as वाश् q.v.
वश (I) a. (f. शा) 1. Subdued, submissive, obedient; 2. charmed, fascinated; 3. subdued by incantations.
वश (II) m.n. 1. Wish, desire; 2. power, influence, control, authority, तयोर्न वशमागच्छेत्तौ ह्यस्य परिपन्थिनौ Bg.iii.34, Megh.i.6, R.viii.19; 3. submission, subjection; 4. birth.

वश (III) m. The residence of harlots.(वशात् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘through the power or influence of.’ वशं इ, गम् or या ‘to yield, to give way,’ R.viii.98. वशं नी or आनी, or वशीकृ ‘to win over, to reduce to subjection.’)
